findings.defect: The repeated 정보를 is a stammer with one omitted subject; the draft invents a shift from I to We.
findings.rationale: Nothing in the line changes the actor. Seogwang is forcing out the same report twice, not correcting I to We.

findings.correction: “He must have said he was being pursued by the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s pursuit party and asked you to help him.”
findings.current: “He must have said he was being pursued by the Jin Family of Taiyuan and asked you to help him.”
findings.defect: 추격대 is omitted; the supposed plea is pursuit by a chase unit, not the family in general.
findings.rationale: 이천백 specifies 추격대 as the content of the false request for aid.
findings.source: “태원진가의 추격대에 쫓기고 있으니 도와 달라고 했겠지.”

findings.correction: If we hire people like that, our sect’s reputation will suffer afterward…
findings.current: If we hire people like that, the sect’s reputation will suffer afterward…
findings.defect: 본문 is the in-group term our/this sect, not a detached the sect.
findings.rationale: Binding glossary: 본문 → our sect / this sect. The speaker is a Mount Heng senior referring to their own sect.
findings.source: 그런 놈들을 고용했다가는 차후에도 본문의 평판이…….

findings.current: The physician clicked his tongue in amazement.
findings.defect: 혀를 내두르다 is astonishment, not the tongue-click of 혀를 차다.
findings.rationale: Clicking the tongue is a different pragmatic cue, usually disapproval; the source is marveling at the recovery.

findings.correction: The chain of debts and grudges would not be broken until one of the two sides fell.
findings.current: The chain of vengeance would not be broken until one of the two sides fell.
findings.defect: 은원 is debts and grudges (恩怨); vengeance alone drops 은.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence already renders 은원 as debts and grudges; the 고리 is that same bond, not vengeance only.
findings.source: 둘 중 하나가 쓰러지기 전까지 은원의 고리는 끊어지지 않는다.

findings.correction: I lay still and fidgeted with my fingers.
findings.current: I lay still and flexed my fingers.
findings.defect: 꼼지락거리다 is fidgeting/wriggling, not a deliberate flex.
findings.rationale: Small hand motion is characterization: idle wriggling while he looks at the calluses, not a muscle flex.
findings.source: 나는 가만히 누운 채로 손을 꼼지락거렸다.

summary: One major subject split in Seogwang’s stammer (I vs We); otherwise localized omissions, a wrong astonishment gesture, and a glossary miss on 본문.
